name: Drive Cars Down A Hill!
desc:
🔥 250+ MPH. Real crash physics. Total destruction.

🏔️ Drive Cars Down a Hill is a high-speed physics sandbox where every run turns into chaos.
Suspension bends, wheels rip off, engines ignite—and momentum decides everything.

💥 Hit ramps, smash through obstacles, and push your run further every time
💰 Earn cash from distance, destruction, and style
🚗 Unlock faster, stronger, and more unpredictable cars

👍 Like + Join for rewards & updates
💻📱🎮 All devices supported
